baseline_point_to_point.description: Fragile point-to-point connections directly coupling source systems to individual supplier schemas.
vulnerabilities: Duplicated business logic and priority rules in 6 places
High regression testing overhead (18 tests per rule change)
Lack of centralized auditability and idempotency guarantees

target_decoupled_architecture.description: Canonical Event-Driven Decoupled Architecture with single source of truth for business rules and isolated supplier adapters.

canonical_layer.name: FastAPI Canonical Event Gateway
responsibilities: Pydantic schema validation for Orders and Forecasts
Centralized business rule evaluation (CR-001 Priority Threshold Engine)
Idempotency and deduplication locking via UUID/correlation keys
Append-only audit trail logging for all event lifecycle transitions
Asynchronous decoupling: resilient to source system delays

benefits: Single business rule component modification for threshold changes
Zero modifications to supplier adapters when internal business logic changes
Automated idempotency eliminates duplicate transmission risks
Immediate rollback capability without supplier code re-deployments
Full audit observability across end-to-end event lifecycle
